extension.description: Classic ASP & VBScript language support powered by the standalone `classic-asp-lsp` server (native Windows / WASM Any OS).
configuration.title: Classic ASP LSP
command.restartServer.title: Classic ASP LSP: Restart Language Server
command.clearCache.title: Classic ASP LSP: Clear Cache
command.toggleLineComment.title: Classic ASP LSP: Toggle Line Comment
command.toggleBlockComment.title: Classic ASP LSP: Toggle Block Comment
command.showReferences.title: Classic ASP LSP: Show References
config.server.path.description: Path to the standalone `classic-asp-lsp` executable or `.wasm` module. Leave empty to use a bundled `server/classic-asp-lsp(.exe|.wasm)` or `classic-asp-lsp` from `PATH`.
config.server.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments passed to the standalone `classic-asp-lsp` server.
config.codeLens.references.description: Show reference-count CodeLens above Classic ASP / VBScript procedures, classes, and top-level declarations.
config.codeLens.includes.description: Show clickable CodeLens above Classic ASP `<!-- #include -->` directives.
config.inlayHints.variableTypes.descript: Show inferred variable type inlay hints (`As Type`) on Classic ASP / VBScript `Dim` and `Const` declarations.
config.inlayHints.returnTypes.descriptio: Show inferred return type inlay hints (`As Type`) on Classic ASP / VBScript `Function` and `Property` declarations.
config.inlayHints.parameterNames.descrip: Show parameter name inlay hints (`param:`) on calls to user-defined Classic ASP / VBScript procedures.
config.inlayHints.scopeMarkers.descripti: Include `(local)` / `(global)` scope markers in Classic ASP / VBScript variable type inlay hints.
config.onTypeFormatting.description: Enable automatic indentation on Enter and `%>` inside Classic ASP / VBScript regions.
config.html.linkedEditing.description:
Enable linked editing for matching HTML opening and closing tags in Classic ASP files (`
` -> ``).
config.js.jsdocTypeStyle.description: Type syntax style used when generating JSDoc comments for JavaScript functions (`typescript` uses `@param {number}` / `any`; `jsdoc` uses Closure/JSDoc `@param {?string}` / `*`). TypeScript files omit `{Type}` automatically.
config.io.networkMode.description: Network-drive / antivirus I/O reduction mode for `#include` files (`auto` detects UNC/network shares and switches to event-driven revalidation, `always` avoids polling `stat()`, `never` uses local TTL only).
config.io.statTtlMs.description: Milliseconds to trust cached local `#include` file metadata before re-checking `stat()` (reduces antivirus scan overhead).
config.io.diskCache.description: Persist `#include` file cache in a local database inside VS Code's extension global storage to avoid re-reading unchanged files over slow network shares.
config.workspace.includes.description: Glob patterns for Classic ASP / VBScript files included in workspace analysis.
config.workspace.excludes.description: Glob patterns for files or directories excluded from Classic ASP / VBScript diagnostics, `#include` merging, and workspace symbols.
config.workspace.respectGitIgnore.descri: Ignore files matched by `.gitignore` in the workspace root during Classic ASP / VBScript analysis.
config.lint.enabled.description: Enable Classic ASP / VBScript lint diagnostics.
config.lint.rules.asp.sql-concat.descrip: Severity override for `asp/sql-concat` (string concatenation in SQL queries).
config.lint.rules.vb.undeclared-var.desc: Severity override for `vb/undeclared-var` (use of undeclared variable).
config.lint.rules.vb.on-error-resume-nex: Severity override for `vb/on-error-resume-next` (broad `On Error Resume Next` usage).
config.lint.rules.vb.unused-var.descript: Severity override for `vb/unused-var` (declared but unused variable).
config.lint.rules.vb.goto-legacy.descrip: Severity override for `vb/goto-legacy` (`On Error GoTo` / legacy label usage).
config.trace.server.description: Trace communication between VS Code and the Classic ASP language server.
